scheme_name: Financial Assistance on Marriage of Sons- Haryana Silicosis Board
description:
The Financial Assistance on Marriage of Sons scheme is an initiative launched by the Haryana Silicosis Board in Haryana, India. 

This scheme was introduced to provide financial support to families affected by silicosis. 

Silicosis is a lung disease caused by inhaling silica dust, which is prevalent among workers in industries such as mining and construction. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board was established in 2016 to address the issues faced by individuals suffering from silicosis and their families. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to alleviate the financial burden on families who have a son getting married. 

The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial assistance of ₹51,000 for the marriage of each son of a silicosis-affected family. 

This amount is intended to help cover the expenses related to the marriage ceremony. 

The scheme is specifically targeted at families where the head of the family has been diagnosed with silicosis. 

To be eligible for this financial assistance, the applicant must be a resident of Haryana. 

The applicant must also be the son of a person who has been diagnosed with silicosis. 

The applicant must provide proof of the silicosis diagnosis through a medical certificate issued by a recognized medical authority. 

Additionally, the applicant must provide proof of the marriage, such as a marriage invitation card or a marriage registration certificate. 

The financial assistance is available only for the marriage of biological sons of the affected individual. 

There are no specific age limits mentioned for the sons who are getting married under this scheme. 

However, the family must demonstrate that they are in need of financial assistance due to the impact of silicosis. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must visit the official website of the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

They can download the application form from the website. 

The completed application form must be submitted along with the required documents. 

Required documents include the medical certificate confirming the diagnosis of silicosis. 

Applicants must also include proof of residence in Haryana. 

The marriage invitation card or marriage registration certificate must also be submitted. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

The board will verify the documents and the eligibility of the applicant. 

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement of funds typically occurs within 30 days of the application approval. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board is responsible for implementing this scheme. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

For any inquiries or assistance, applicants can contact the Haryana Silicosis Board at their official office. 

The contact details are available on the Haryana Silicosis Board's official website. 

The scheme was launched to provide timely support to families facing the challenges of silicosis. 

It recognizes the social and economic impact of the disease on families. 

The financial assistance is intended to promote the welfare of families affected by silicosis. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort by the Haryana government to support marginalized communities. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board also provides other forms of assistance to silicosis-affected individuals. 

This includes medical treatment and rehabilitation support. 

The board aims to create awareness about silicosis and its prevention. 

The scheme has been positively received by the community. 

Many families have benefited from the financial assistance provided for marriages. 

The amount of ₹51,000 is seen as a significant help in managing marriage expenses. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to supporting vulnerable populations. 

It aims to reduce the stigma associated with silicosis. 

The financial assistance helps families celebrate marriages with dignity. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The board is also working on expanding its outreach to ensure more families are aware of the assistance available. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to educate families about the scheme. 

The board collaborates with local organizations to reach affected families. 

The Financial Assistance on Marriage of Sons scheme is a crucial step in addressing the needs of families impacted by silicosis. 

It provides not just financial support but also emotional relief to families during significant life events. 

The scheme is an example of targeted welfare initiatives by the government of Haryana. 

It aims to uplift families struggling with the consequences of occupational diseases. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board is dedicated to improving the quality of life for affected individuals and their families. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the challenges faced by these families. 

Overall, the Financial Assistance on Marriage of Sons scheme plays a vital role in supporting the social fabric of families affected by silicosis in Haryana. 

The scheme continues to evolve based on the needs of the community and the feedback received from beneficiaries. 

It stands as a model for similar initiatives in other states to address occupational health issues. 

The Haryana government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of its citizens through such targeted schemes.
